اجتنبت (form VIII)
# اِجْتَنَبْتُ (ijtanabtu) /id͡ʒ.ta.nab.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِجْتَنَبَ (ijtanaba)
# اِجْتَنَبْتَ (ijtanabta) /id͡ʒ.ta.nab.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِجْتَنَبَ (ijtanaba)
# اِجْتَنَبْتِ (ijtanabti) /id͡ʒ.ta.nab.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِجْتَنَبَ (ijtanaba)
# اِجْتَنَبَتْ (ijtanabat) /id͡ʒ.ta.na.bat/: thi
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
